programme.desc: Anna Arnardóttir, a renowned volcanologist, notices signs of dangerous eruptions near Reykjavík.Despite the warnings, the authorities do not believe her.The affair with the photographer also complicates the woman's private life.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
programme.desc: The authorities of the Midtown School of Science and Technology are organizing a two-week expedition to the Old Continent.Tour participants visit, among others, Venice.The city is attacked by a powerful Water Elemental.Peter Parker tries to save his friends, but he is powerless against the creature.Fortunately, Mysterio comes to his aid and kills the creature.A mysterious savior once lived in an alternate reality.He convinces Parker to engage in the fight against the creatures that were supposed to destroy his civilization.The boy refuses because he wants to live the life of an ordinary teenager and find happiness with MJ.As a result of a trick involving Nick Fury, he changes his mind.He makes a disastrous decision when he gives Beck the glasses he inherited from his mentor Tony Stark, which enable him to take control of the artificial intelligence created by the millionaire.He must correct his mistake as soon as possible.

programme.title: Minecraft
programme.desc: Garrett (Jason Momoa), Henry (Sebastian Hansen), Natalie (Emma Myers) and Dawn (Danielle Brooks) constantly struggle with problems.The lives of these four change when a magical portal pulls them into a strange land full of cubes.The Overworld turns out to be a place where everything is possible thanks to imagination, which, however, is sometimes difficult to control.Once there, Garrett, Henry, Natalie and Dawn meet Steve (Jack Black), who was trapped on this side of the portal many years earlier.Together with him, they decide to defend the unusual land from evil creatures called piglins.For them to succeed, they will have to show courage and discover qualities that will make it easier for them to find their place in the real world later.A hit production for the whole family, inspired by the popular game.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: The friendly bear Boguś, raised by humans, leads an idyllic life in the park, where he is a tourist attraction.One day, the teddy bear meets a one-horned deer, the mischievous Elliot, who is persuaded to go on a trip together and gets into trouble.Boguś's guardian decides that it is time for the bear to live in a natural environment.The animal cannot cope outside civilization at all.He can't find his way home either.Moreover, the hunting season is just starting.Carefree Elliot and his helpless companion are now in real danger.Together, they convince the forest inhabitants to join forces and oppose the armed newcomers.

programme.title: The List
programme.desc: Matt is cheating on his fiancée Abby with a celebrity from the "exceptions to monogamy" list.The hurt woman decides to pay him back in kind.

programme.title: Veep 5
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).When Selina Meyer unexpectedly takes over as president after her predecessor stepped down, the entire team must meet a new challenge.

programme.title: Veep 5
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).When Selina Meyer unexpectedly takes over as president after her predecessor stepped down, the entire team must meet a new challenge.

programme.title: First Man
programme.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programme.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programme.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programme.title: You Gotta Believe
programme.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programme.title: Blue Moon
programme.desc: The year is 1943. The legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart (Ethan Hawke), co-author of such hits as "Blue Moon" and "My Funny Valentine", spends the night from March 31 to April 1 in Sardi's bar.In the company of friends, including his muse Elizabeth Weiland (Margaret Qualley), he struggles with wounded pride and shaken self-confidence.At this time, his former long-time collaborator Richard Rodgers (Andrew Scott) celebrates the premiere of his musical entitled"Oklahoma!", which he wrote with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney).Two Oscar nominations.

programme.title: The Dark Wizard
programme.desc: Biography of the legendary climber, BASE jumper and slackliner.Dean Potter specialized in free solo ascents, speed climbing and slacklining without belays.An important element of his activity was crossing the boundaries of style and combining disciplines: climbing, highline and BASE jumping.He was the precursor of free BASE, i.e. solo climbing using a parachute as the only protection.In Yosemite he set speed and free solo records.His activities had a significant impact on setting risk limits, which raised ethical controversies in the community.He died in 2015 in Yosemite Valley.

programme.title: One, two, three... You're in the game
programme.desc: Salem, Massachusetts, a town marked by a history of witch hunts.Jonah (Benjamin Evan Ainsworth) and his older brother Marcus (Asa Butterfield) come across an abandoned cabin while biking through the forest.They find a diary and a knife with a mysterious inscription on its blade.When read to her, it evokes a demon that forces young people to participate in macabre versions of children's games - from hide and seek to tag.The brothers, their sister Billy (Natalia Dyer) and her friends take part in the bloody showdown.They discover that this competition from hell cannot be won.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programme.title: Goodbye, Christopher Robin
programme.desc: End of World War I.A.A.Milne (Domhnall Gleeson) moves to the countryside with his family and, finding inspiration in the toys of his son Christopher Robin (Will Tilston), creates a story about the adventures of Winnie the Pooh, who will soon become a children's favorite.However, the quickly achieved international success is not only about profits.The price of A.A.'s fameMilne will suffer not only himself, but also his wife Daphne (Margot Robbie), their son and his caregiver Olive (Kelly Macdonald).The moving film with biographical elements received a BIFA nomination for best supporting actress - Kelly Macdonald.The music composed by Carter Burwell was appreciated by the World Academy of Film Music.

credits.actor: Christopher Robin Aged 6 Months - Stanley Hamlin

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Millions of smartphones around the world have an application for sending messages through which you can communicate your feelings and moods.This is where the city of Textopolis, where emotes live, is hidden.The task of each of them is to express a different state of mind.The exception is Minek, who can express every emotion.However, he dreams of being like others.Together with Piątek and the superhacker Matrix, they set off on a journey through the phone in search of a solution.The animated film is directed by Tony Leondis ("Kung Fu Panda: Secrets of the Masters").The Polish language version featured, among others: Paweł Ciołkosz, Szymon Roszak, Monika Pikuła and Katarzyna Kwiatkowska.

programme.title: Oscar's Eye
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Oscar cannot speak.Because of this, he is rejected and bullied by his peers.However, he becomes friends with the owner of the workshop, Eric, with whom he shares a common passion - photography.

programme.title: The Book of Life
programme.desc: Two powerful magicians bet whether people are pure in heart.La Muerte is the ruler of the World of the Remembered.The dead stay there, remaining in the hearts of their loved ones.Xibalba rules the Land of the Forgotten - a sad place for souls that no one remembers.The magicians are tested by: fashion matador Manolo, who dreams of being a musician, and Joaquin - an athlete and the pride of the city.The boys compete for the affections of Maria, the daughter of the local mayor.However, the beautiful bride is resistant to their advances.Manolo and Joaquin will go on a wonderful journey, during which they will visit extraordinary lands, meet colorful characters and discover the truth about themselves.The project by Guillermo del Toro and Jorge R. Gutierrez was nominated for a Golden Globe in the category of best animated film.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
programme.desc: 1970s, Boston.Cam Stuart (Mark Ruffalo) suffers from bipolar disorder.Due to his illness, he had to be hospitalized and lost his job.One day, his wife, nurse Maggie (Zoe Saldana), accepts a scholarship to New York University.The MBA degree obtained there will help her find a well-paid job, thanks to which she will provide for her family and take care of her children's education.While staying in another city, her husband has to take care of his daughters - adolescent Amelia (Imogene Wolodarsky) and Faith (Ashley Aufderheide).He faces an exceptionally difficult task.Girls are often embarrassed by the behavior of their father, who keeps coming up with various unusual ideas.However, they help him face everyday challenges.

programme.title: Caught Stealing
programme.desc: 1990s. Former baseball player Hank Thompson (Austin Butler) works as a bartender in a New York pub.He has a great girlfriend (Zoë Kravitz) and a championship-fighting team.His calm and orderly life changes when his neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to look after his cat for a few days.Then, out of nowhere, a gang of gangsters attacks Hank.Puerto Ricans, Russians and Jews are out to get him and he has no idea why.He will only find out what's going on if his wits and luck allow him to stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Industry
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of young bankers in Great Britain.Pierpoint, Harper (Myha'la) and Yasmin (Marisa Abela) live the lavish life they dreamed of as graduates.The financiers are drawn into a tense game when a fintech genius appears on the London scene.Yasmin develops a relationship with Sir Henry Muck (Kit Harington), and Harper is drawn into the web of influence of the mysterious director, Whitney Halberstram (Max Minghella).Under the pressure of money and power, the friendship of young women is put to the test.

programme.title: The Knick 2
programme.desc: The further fate of the staff of New York's Knickerbocker Hospital.Dr. Thackery is in a New England rehab clinic trying to break free from addiction.The team tries to cope in his absence.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Pitt
programme.desc: Collins, along with Langdon and Javadi, tends to the boys responsible for stealing and crashing the ambulance.Meanwhile, Kristi locks herself in the bathroom and refuses to leave without the abortion drugs.Collins tries to intervene.Santos drops his scalpel and accidentally injures Garcia.Gloria warns Robby that an outside company will take control of the hospital if patient satisfaction scores do not improve.The doctor tells Nick's parents that their son is brain dead.He introduces them to family support specialist Emma and asks for permission to donate his son's organs.During the conversation, the boy's mother leaves the room.Santos and Langdon inform Joseph that he suffers from neurocysticercosis.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators Ed (Patrick Wilson) and Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) Warren face a new challenge.Mysterious forces threaten the life of their daughter, Judy.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: The year 2050. Mickey Barnes (Robert Pattinson) takes out a loan on usurious terms.Wanting to escape from an aggressive debt collector, together with his friend Timo (Steven Yeun), he joins the crew of a spaceship that is to colonize the ice planet Niflheim.However, when the second of them becomes a shuttle pilot, Mickey - not entirely consciously - becomes the person assigned to the most dangerous tasks.When he dies, in a process called reprinting, a clone of himself is created, which retains his memories.The situation of the version of man number 17 becomes even more complicated when, contrary to expectations, he is not killed during one of the missions, and when he returns to the ship, he finds Mickey 18 there. In these circumstances, the commander of the expedition, Hieronymous Marshall (Mark Ruffalo), decides to eliminate both of them.A surprising, fast-paced and humorous picture by the Oscar-winning writer and director of "Parasite", Bong Joon Ho.The production is an adaptation of the novel by Edward Ashton.

programme.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programme.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.

programme.title: Brett Goldstein: The Second Best Night of Your Life
programme.desc: British actor, satirist and writer Brett Goldstein presents a monologue in which he shares his funny observations about love, sex, masculinity, but also "Sesame Street".

programme.title: Barry 4
programme.desc: The last installment of the adventures of a paid killer who decided to change his life and tried his hand at acting.As a result of recent events, but primarily because of his criminal past, Barry (Bill Hader) goes to prison.His arrest was led by Gene Cousineau (Henry Winkler), an acting teacher who is now considered a hero by many.Barry's situation has a negative impact on his relationship with Sally (Sarah Goldberg).Gradually, the lonely and betrayed man breaks down and vows revenge.

programme.title: Barry 4

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programme.title: The Addams Family 2
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are distraught that their children are growing up so fast.Wednesday and Pugsley increasingly prefer to spend time alone rather than devote it to their parents.Morticia is downright distraught that her children even neglect meals together.To reconnect with her offspring, Gomez comes up with a great idea.He even forces Wednesday, Pugsley, Uncle Fester and the rest of the gang into a haunted camper to go with them on their last, completely miserable family vacation.Traveling across America is full of adventures.During this time, the family will face many complications.She organizes a barrel race in Niagara Falls, visits the Headless Horseman's hometown, causes a massive explosion in the Grand Canyon, and finally causes a collective panic attack during a girls' talent competition.

programme.title: Warcraft
programme.desc: The Orcs face extinction when their homeworld, Draenor, is torn apart by a mysterious force.In this situation, the sorcerer Gul'dan unites the clans into the Horde and then opens a portal to the land of Azeroth.He leads a small battle group through the gate.Powerful creatures attack human-inhabited territory.The ruler of the invaded land asks the magician Medivh to help him defeat giant creatures.The king's brother-in-law, the brave knight Anduin Lothar, also sets off to fight the unequal fight against the intruders.Soon, the magician Khadgar discovers that the invaders managed to open a passage between the worlds thanks to the support of one of the people.To save the country from destruction, the daredevils must find the traitor as quickly as possible.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programme.title: Ainda Estou Aqui
programme.desc: Brazil, 1971. A military dictatorship is gaining strength in the country, and the lives of citizens are disrupted by detentions, disappearances and acts of violence.In these dangerous times, the Paiva family tries to live a peaceful life in Rio de Janeiro.Everything changes when one day the family patriarch, Rubens (Selton Mello), a former congressman, is summoned for a mysterious interrogation by military investigators.Soon, the officers arrest Eunice Paiva (Fernanda Torres), the mother of the family.She is kept in prison for 12 days and put under pressure to hand over her friends and associates accused of opposition activities.The traumatic experience becomes the beginning of Eunice's profound transformation.After leaving prison, she is forced to find herself again - she fights for the truth as an activist.Its goal is to expose the government's illegal actions and fight for justice for thousands of victims of the regime.

programme.title: Esperando a Dalí
programme.desc: Barcelona, ​​1974, a period of intense opposition to Franco's dictatorship.Brothers Fernando (Ivan Massagué), a chef, and Alberto (Pol López), an activist, must hide from the authorities.They find shelter in Cadaqués, a picturesque seaside village that is also the home of the famous artist Salvador Dalí (Gal Soler).In this setting, the brothers meet Lola (Clara Ponsot), who helps them find work.Fernando, influenced by Dalí's works and his infatuation with women, finds a passion for creating unique dishes.The man's ambitions grow, especially when Jules (José Garcia), Lola's eccentric father, dreams of organizing a dinner for Dalí himself.Despite the difficulties, Fernando creates a culinary masterpiece that inspires a revolution in the world of taste, which leads to the creation of the famous Surreal restaurant.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: New York.Young Nathan Drake (Tom Holland), a descendant of the explorer Francis Drake, works as a bartender in an upscale establishment where he does not hesitate to rob his wealthy customers from time to time.At the same time, the boy believes that he knows where the legendary Eldorado is.One day, he is visited at a bar by experienced treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan (Mark Wahlberg).The man invites the boy to participate in an expedition to find the treasure of the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, who was lost 500 years ago.Together they set off on a crazy and adventurous journey.It soon turns out that they have to hurry, because the ruthless Santiago Moncada (Antonio Banderas) and the mercenary Jo Braddock (Tati Gabrielle) are also looking for the valuables.In addition, the travelers try to find Nathan's missing brother, and because it is sometimes difficult for them to communicate, they learn to cooperate.A spectacular adaptation of a popular video game.

The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.desc: This series follows Lakha, Bablu and Dablu on brand-new wild adventures. Pine Tree Mountain has become a preserve that draws visitors from all around to see its natural beauty and wildlife. This wildlife now includes some new but familiar residents: Hugo and friends from the hit movie, The Big Top Secret!

programme.title: Cindrella
programme.desc: Young Cinderella, struggling with abuse from her stepmother and stepsisters, receives help from her fairy godmother and animal friends while finding adventure and romance with a dashing man who hides the fact that he is a prince.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster Paln
programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Fury Spinner
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.desc: Step into the Bay of Fundy’s surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the world’s fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in nature’s great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing – water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It’s a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word “oukurubes” which means “place of thunder” in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Grévy’s zebras population has dropped by 50% in less than 20 years. Environmentalists say that if we aren’t vigilant, they could disappear all together. Lewa Conservancy is at the heart of efforts to protect the species so that they can replenish their numbers.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that won’t go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks she’s a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it’s warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring.

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. programme.title: Macro Worlds

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: "There is nothing wrong with your television set." That famous line opens each episode of the classic science fiction anthology series as part of a narration that makes people think their TVs are being controlled. Episodes of the series, which numbered 49 over the course of two seasons, range from a mix of sci-fi and horror that feature "scary monster" motifs to episodes focused on the sci-fi aspects of the stories. Episode writers include such notables as series creator Leslie Stevens and Harlan Ellison.

programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: Predator Fails
programme.desc: Lions, panthers and other predators arouse admiration as reliable hunters.However, hunting down prey requires a lot of effort from them.Very often, their search for prey ends in failure, which means hunger.Viewers will see how the most famous hunters in the animal world cope.They will learn how strength, speed, strategy and teamwork make predators successful in chasing, fighting and killing.They will see the difference between ocean hunters and forest hunters and savannah kings.The creators of the series show how poisonous venom, sharp claws and huge mouths are used.They also present survival strategies for potential victims, who often manage to escape the predator.

programme.title: Genghis Khan: the Secret History of the Mongols
programme.desc: A profile of a man who went down in history as a brilliant military strategist.The six-episode series will present little-known facts from the life of the fearless leader.The authors will show how, after a difficult childhood and captivity, he managed to gain power, unite the quarreling tribes, build an invincible army and subjugate all those who opposed him, including his former allies.Impressive conquests will be discussed, including:expansion into the West, campaigns against the neighboring Tangut people and the Chinese Jin Empire.The troops he commanded were known for the mobility of their cavalry, carrying out rapid attacks and retreats, and applying psychological pressure on their opponents.They used innovative techniques when besieging even well-fortified cities.Genghis Khan became one of the most important figures in history, expanding his empire to unprecedented sizes.It stretched from the Pacific to the Caspian and Black Seas.The creators of the series are based on a new translation of the anonymous chronicle "The Secret History of the Mongols", which is the oldest known written monument of the steppe peoples of Central Asia.

programme.title: Chernobyl: Inside the Meltdown
programme.desc: On April 26, 1986, an explosion destroyed the fourth block of the Chernobyl power plant.The accident was caused by design defects in the reactor and errors during the safety test.It was the worst nuclear disaster in history.The explosion released 400 times more radiation than the bomb dropped on Hiroshima.40 years after the tragedy, its consequences will be shown - from KGB activities to military operations in Ukraine.There will be plenty of witness accounts that will shed new light on the dramatic events.The speakers will include:a liquidator working on the roof of reactor 3, and journalist Wyatt Andrews, who was covering the information blackout in Moscow.

programme.title: World War II: History On Trial
programme.desc: The beginning of 1946. A trial against war criminals is underway in Nuremberg.The defense presents its own version of events, putting the idea of ​​a fair trial to the test.Prosecutors must maintain a coherent line of argument when Hermann Göring plays a game that could undermine the authority of the tribunal.In the same year, the trial of 28 Japanese criminals begins in Tokyo.There, however, unlike the orderly Nuremberg, tensions, disputes and political compromises are mounting in the courtroom.

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: A story about the Sovietization process, from 1944 to the construction of the Berlin Wall.After World War II, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe found themselves in the Soviet zone.The events that led to such a division of the Old Continent will be presented.Viewers will learn how it affected the everyday lives of citizens of these countries and what forms of resistance they encountered.Experts will explain the mechanisms of Soviet domination.There will be witnesses' accounts, interviews, discussions of scientific works and archives including propaganda films, home recordings and fictional stories. After Stalin's death, it became possible to introduce reforms in the USSR.Protests broke out in Czechoslovakia and Bulgaria, and the strike in the GDR turned into a national uprising.On the night of February 24-25, 1956, Nikita Khrushchev delivered a secret report during the 20th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, in which he condemned the criminal system created by his predecessor.In October, there was a revolt in Poland, and a month later Soviet tanks crushed the Hungarian uprising.Five years later, the Berlin Wall, a symbol of the division of Europe, was built.

programme.title: Jamie's Super Food
programme.desc: In this programme, on the Greek island of Ikaria Jamie finds out how whole grain cracked wheat – which could be one of the reasons local people live so long – is prepared the traditional way and helps make a tasty Ikarian speciality, Trahana. Meanwhile, on the Japanese island of Okinawa, Jamie discovers the super food secrets behind local fruit, vegetables, herbs and spices and learns the islanders' belief in Nuchi Gusui – 'let food be your medicine' – from 95-year-old Shoei Kingo who incorporates all the health-giving food he grows into his diet to build a life bursting with vitality. Bringing what he's learnt back to the UK, Jamie creates a days' worth of super-nutritious and delicious meals, including: a super-charged 'health bomb' breakfast of Black Rice Pudding, Mango, Lime, Passion Fruit & Coconut; delicious Green Tea Roasted Salmon, Ginger Rice and Sunshine Salad for a lunch that will make you smile and beautiful Seared Turmeric Chicken, Houmous, Peppers, Couscous & Greens for d.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: Academy Award® nominee Ian McKellen takes on the iconic role of Detective Sherlock Holmes in this exciting new twist on the world’s most famous detective. In 1947, the world famous sleuth has retired to a remote Sussex farmhouse, living in relative anonymity with only his housekeeper Mrs Munro and her young son, Roger, for company. Grappling with the diminishing powers of his mind — and frustrated with the misrepresentation of him in Watson’s best-selling novels — he diverts his attention to an unsolved case. As the mystery deepens, Sherlock tries desperately to recall the events of 30 years ago that ultimately led to his retirement.

programme.title: The 39 Steps

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: When Mary Lennox's parents suddenly die, she is sent to live with her uncle, Archibald Craven, on his remote country estate deep in the Yorkshire moors. While exploring, she discovers a hidden magical garden.

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: There are a million reasons not to like realtor Oren Little, and that's just the way he likes it. Wilfully obnoxious to anyone who might cross his path, he wants nothing more than to sell one last house and retire in peace and quiet, until his estranged son suddenly drops off a granddaughter he never knew existed and turns his life upside-down. Clueless about how to care for a sweet, abandoned nine-year-old, he pawns her off to his determined and lovable neighbour Leah and tries to resume his life uninterrupted. But little by little, Oren stubbornly learns to open his heart to his family, to Leah and to life itself.

programme.title: Harold And Maude
programme.desc: Harold is a young man obsessed with death, Maude is a septuagenarian with a passion for life. They meet at a funeral. Harold makes Maude laugh with stories about his suicide attempts, she inspires him by stealing the priest's car.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham, a corporate hatchet man who loves his life on the road, is forced to fight for his job when his company downsizes its travel budget. He is required to spend more time at home just as he is on the cusp of a goal he's worked toward for years: reaching five million frequent flyer miles and just after he's met the frequent-traveler woman of his dreams.

programme.title: Transcendence
programme.desc: Dr. Will Caster is the foremost researcher in the field of Artificial Intelligence, working to create a sentient machine that combines the collective intelligence of everything ever known with the full range of human emotions. His highly controversial experiments have made him famous, but they have also made him the prime target of anti-technology extremists who will do whatever it takes to stop him. However, in their attempt to destroy Will, they inadvertently become the catalyst for him to succeed—to be a participant in his own transcendence. For his wife Evelyn and best friend Max Waters, both fellow researchers, the question is not if they can…but if they should. Their worst fears are realized as Will’s thirst for knowledge evolves into a seemingly omnipresent quest for power, to what end is unknown. The only thing that is becoming terrifyingly clear is there may be no way to stop him.

programme.title: Banel & Adama
programme.desc: Banel and Adama are fiercely in love. The young married couple lives in a remote village in northern Senegal. For them, nothing else exists except each other. But for the rest of their tight-knit village, duty dictates that Adama soon accept the role of chief. The two lovers have their own plans… until something in the air changes. The rains do not come, the cattle begin to die, the men leave. The curse weighs on Adama's sense of duty, and the chasm between them drives Banel into a feverish, mystical chaos. A rare debut feature that premiered in competition at the Cannes Film Festival, and Senegal's official submission to the 96th Academy Awards, \.

programme.desc: In this eerie, existential western directed by Monte Hellman and written by Carole Eastman (Five Easy Pieces), Warren Oates and Will Hutchins play a bounty hunter and his sidekick who are talked by a mysterious woman (Millie Perkins) into leading her into the desert on a murkily motivated revenge mission. Things are further complicated by the addition to their crew of an enigmatic drifter (Jack Nicholson) who seems to delight in sadistically toying with the two men. Hellman’s singular odyssey is a vision of the weird old west unlike any other, a spare and challenging work leading to a provocative ending.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance.

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: When Jeff (Jason Segel) leaves his mother's basement to buy wood glue at the store, he looks for signs from the universe to determine his path. However, a series of unexpected and amusing events leads him to cross paths with his family, especially his brother (Ed Helms), in the strangest of circumstances and locations. If Jeff is very lucky and universally blessed, he will find the meaning of his life... and remember to buy the wood glue as well.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Lifelong friends travel to Key West, Fla., to be bridesmaids in a college girlfriend's surprise wedding. Over the course of one outrageous trip, sisterhoods are rekindled, the past resurfaces, and there are enough sparks, sex and romance to change all of their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City: A Dame to Kill For

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Finding Samantha struggling to repair a lamp, Aunt Clara uses her uncertain powers of magic to summon an electrician. Benjamin Franklin, in l8th century clothes, appears. Samantha is upset by Ben's presence and Aunt Clara's wail that she can't remember how to undo the spell. Darrin, astonished by Ben's appearance in his home, can't convince Larry Tate that Ben is not is creation for an advertising campaign for Franklin Elec-tronics. Abner Kravitz refuses to believe Gladys' report that the real Ben Franklin is at the Stephens'. Bowing to Samantha's pleas, Darrin agrees to allow her and Aunt Clara to show Ben how his inventions are being used is the city. The next morning Ben, leaving a note that he has decided to tour the city alone to avoid causing domestic discord, sets out. Darrin, Samantha and Aunt Clara start searching for him. At a firehouse, inspecting an old fire engine, Ben steps on the accelerator. The engine shoots out into the street and slams into a curb. Ben is arrested and taken to court, where the judge, sure it is all a publicity stunt, charges him with grand larceny and sets bail at a thousand dollars. Darrin puts up the bail, knowing he will lose it if Ben doesn't appear for trial is a month. Just then, Aunt Clara remembers the spell and Ben vanishes.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Seattle, a city full of contrasts, is known as both the birthplace of grunge and the headquarters of technology giants, including:Amazon and Microsoft.In the 1990s, it was known for the music of bands such as Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Soundgarden and Alice in Chains.Marcin Prokop will meet the author of a book about Kurt Cobain, visit a photographer who collaborates with important grunge artists and talk to the owner of a music store in the Georgetown district, who will share interesting anecdotes about the Nirvana singer.A key experience will be a visit to the Sub Pop label and a conversation with its founder, Jonathan Poneman, who had a huge impact on the development of the contemporary music scene, promoting bands such as Nirvana and The Shins.The culmination of this trip will be an important conversation for Marcin with Kim Thail, the vocalist of Soundgarden.

programme.desc: There is an energy-saving house by Justyna and Piotr in Smolniki, Greater Poland.The building, located in the middle of the forest, has direct access to the lake and is equipped with solar panels that give the owners independence.Joanna and Artur, parents of three children, moved into the house from a two-room apartment.Their priority was low electricity bills.Thanks to the use of modern solutions, life for a family of five does not generate high costs.Marcin, a sailing enthusiast, built a floating house that is moored on Lake Charzykowskie.The nature surrounding the building influenced the energy-saving solutions used in it.

programme.title: Man v Food 2
programme.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known as America's playground, attracts crowds of tourists eager for entertainment and nightlife.This city full of neon lights, casinos and concerts is also a place where many people find employment.Marcin Prokop goes to Nevada to look at the lives of employees behind the scenes.He meets Nicole, whose dream is to become an erotic dancer in one of the clubs.After her stay in Barcelona, ​​she returns to Las Vegas to start her career.The host also talks to Internet creator Steve, who describes everyday life in the city and the threats that may await people here.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: More than 170,000 members of this tribe live on the Navajo Nation reservation.The picturesque areas located in four states were supposed to be an enclave of free Indians.In fact, they often resemble vast ghettos.The history of the Navajo is rich and painful, as Marcin Prokop discovers during a visit to one of the last living cryptographers from this tribe, who fought in the Pacific during World War II.The next hero is Loren Anthony, who grew up in the mountains, living in primitive conditions.As a teenager, he formed a metal band, which allowed him to express generational frustrations.After various life challenges, Loren decided to focus on music, charity work and supporting his community.For many young residents of the reserve, this type of creativity is a way to shout out wrongs and escape from the sad reality.Navajos fight stereotypes, valuing the value of their community and traditions, which encourages them to remain in the difficult areas of the reservation.

programme.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programme.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programme.desc: For the fifth time, Martyna Wojciechowska sets off on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: After several years of efforts, Martyna receives permission to come to China.He visits the Shaolin Valley area, where the influence of the traditional, strict upbringing of the Chinese is most clearly visible.Currently, over 5,000 students study at the school, which originates from a legendary Buddhist monastery.He teaches them, among others:Liu Yin Ping, a fifth-degree kung fu master.She is the only woman who lives on the school premises with her husband, the vice-champion of martial arts in all of China.The woman has a five-year-old son, but she also has to be a mother to her children, the youngest of whom are five years old.Students start their day at 5:40 a.m., and at 6:00 a.m. they have their first martial arts training.They spend all their time at school and visit their parents only once a year.They believe they can achieve any goal, they just have to work hard enough.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Every year, surrogate mothers in India give birth to approximately 25,000 babies.Nearly half of this number are 'orders' from Western couples.In Annand, Martyna meets Dr. Nyana Patel, who runs a fertility clinic and a surrogacy home.About eighty pregnant women are under her care.They are usually young and often illiterate girls from small towns, who thus earn the equivalent of ten years' income in just 9 months.The demand for their services is huge.The Polish traveler learns the stories of women who decided to rent their bodies to give birth to children to other people.He meets Manisia, who has three children of her own, and a married couple who, thanks to Dr. Patel and one of the surrogates, have the desired offspring.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Thailand, any teenager can legally buy and use hormones that will enable him to change his gender if he feels the need.Operations changing men into women and vice versa are also carried out on a massive scale in the country.Martyna meets a doctor who runs the oldest clinic in Bangkok offering this type of services, and assists him during the procedure.The traveler also meets his patients and looks behind the scenes of the selection of the most beautiful ladyboys in Thailand.He also meets a talented dancer, Lukpad, whom he accompanies in his everyday life and during preparations for the show in which she appears.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places There is a place in downtown Los Angeles that tourists and locals alike stay away from.Tens of thousands of people who have become homeless camp every day in the Skid Row district.Pastor Troy runs a center that helps people in crisis of homelessness get back on their feet.Marcin learns the story of a priest who also struggled with a serious life crisis and now devotes all his energy to supporting others.The leader continues his journey to Slab City, a settlement located on the site of a former military base inhabited by those who want to live on their own terms.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Marcin will meet with Carrie, a representative of the Mormon community, to find out what their faith is based on.This church was founded in 1830, and its followers, fleeing from persecution, settled in Utah and founded the city of Salt Lake City.The guide will also take the leader to meet his family.This will be an opportunity to find out whether the controversies that have been stirring up the lifestyle of followers of this religion for years and the myths circulating about it are confirmed in reality.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Marcin Prokop will meet a man who gave up the pursuit of a career and money in favor of a sense of freedom and communion with nature.An American Air Force pilot gave up everything to live in a small truck and constantly travel.The host talks to him about where this idea came from and whether he regrets it.The journalist will also reach Zion National Park.Kim, who works as a guide in this place, will tell Marcin about what being close to nature gives him and why he is guided by the wabi-sabi philosophy.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places The presenter goes to Denver to meet with representatives of the Soldiers of Jesus.They say that they exist to train faithful disciples, preach the word of God and bear witness to the Gospel among the motorcyclist community.One of the members of the organization, Smoking Mike, tells Marcin about his dark past and the path he had to take to finally find peace and happiness.The leader continues his journey to meet Amberley, who suffered a spinal injury several years earlier as a result of an accident and uses a wheelchair.Thanks to her passion and religion, she found the strength to put her life back together.She is still an active rodeo competitor and horses are her great love.

programme.title: A Mother's Instinct
programme.desc: When a boy goes missing, clues lead his sister and mother to believe their asocial neighbor was involved in the abduction; forcing them to take the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Escape from Polygamy
programme.desc: Ryder and Julina have just fallen madly in love. But this passionate romance is forbidden - it goes against the laws of their polygamous community. Things only get more complicated when Ryder's father declares that God has chosen Julina to be his wife.

programme.title: June Again
programme.desc: During a fleeting bout of lucidity from her dementia, June Wilton has precious little time to bring together her estranged children, save the family business, and rekindle an old flame.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 3
programme.desc: Sheriff Dan Tashtego joins forces with a group of monster hunters and ropes in officer Davis Tubbs to help stop the creature from its feeding spree.

programme.title: All I See Is You
programme.desc: Gina (Blake Lively: The Shallows) and husband James (Jason Clarke: Everest) have an almost perfect marriage. After being blinded as a child in a nearly fatal car crash, Gina exclusively depends on James to feel and ‘see’ the world around her, and it appears only to solidify their extremely passionate relationship. While the two enjoy a colourful existence living in Bangkok, their relationship is upended when Gina receives a corneal transplant and regains her sight. With her restored vision, Gina experiences the world with a new sense of wonder and independence which James finds threatening. It is only when Gina suddenly begins to lose her sight again that she finally realises the disturbing reality of their marriage... All I See Is You is directed by Hollywood heavyweight Marc Forster (World War Z, Quantum of Solace), and also stars Danny Huston (American Horror Story, Wonder Woman).

programme.title: Memoirs of an Invisible Man
programme.desc: After a freak accident, a company executive turns completely invisible, goes on the run, and becomes hunted by a treacherous CIA official while trying to cope with his new reality.

programme.title: Zulu (1964)
programme.desc: Outnumbered British soldiers do battle with Zulu warriors at Rorke's Drift.

programme.title: A Costume for Nicolas
programme.desc: Nicolás goes to live with Mia and Tomás, his loving grandparents, and his cousin David, who suffers from scary nightmares. Nicolás helps David overcome his fears with his vivid imagination, his sense of adventure and….. his trunk of fantastic costumes.

programme.title: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
programme.desc: Maya is a determined little bee, but sometimes her determination can get her into sticky situations. When Maya accidentally embarrasses the Empress of Buzztropolis, she is forced to venture beyond her colony and team up with a group of mis-fit bugs in a bid to win The Honey Games and save her life.

programme.title: Dino Time
programme.desc: Three kids who travel back in time to 65 million years ago, where they are taken in by a dinosaur. AKA Back to the Jurassic

programme.title: Earthsea: Part 1
programme.desc: If you love Harry Potter, you'll love acclaimed fantasy author Ursula K. Le Guin's epic tale of wizardry and prophecy. Ged, a reckless youth is destined to become the greatest sorcerer that the mystical land of Earthsea has ever known.

programme.title: Earthsea: Part 2
programme.desc: Ged continues his fight with the shadow, while Tenar is accused of killing the mother. Together with his friend, Ged comes to Antuan. The king is planing to let the evil out.

programme.title: Somewhere Tomorrow
programme.desc: A teenage girl sees a plane crash and ends up chatting with one of the injured passengers, but later discovers that he was already dead from the crash.

programme.title: Kat and the Band
programme.desc: Seventeen year old, music obsessed school girl Kat Malone tricks her way into managing struggling band Dollar Days, pretending to be a band manager in her twenties.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.
